mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 11 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 1.

Kosovo observed its Force Day on November 27 with a central ceremony at the Adem Jashari barracks in Pristina, where Democratic Party leader Vlora Çitaku and a parliamentary deputy congratulated the armed forces.

North Macedonia announced a €500 million investment plan and said its security forces are moving toward full operational capability with the aim of joining NATO.

Kosovo and Italy have completed the update of their reciprocal recognition agreement, easing administrative procedures for Kosovo citizens living in Italy.

Prime Minister Albin Kurti declared that Kosovo deserves EU candidate status and called for urgent acceleration of accession negotiations.

Albania's Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs plans to fund Albanian-language teachers and strengthen Albanian schools in Italy starting in 2027.
